name: Da Nang to Da Lat
summary: Fly. The flight is about 1 hour 5 minutes to Lien Khuong, about 30 km south of town. There is no train into Da Lat. A road time is Check on arrival.

modes.note: About 1 hour 5 minutes each way. Lien Khuong is about 30 km south of Da Lat, and the ride into town is extra. Fares are Check on arrival.
Da Lat’s line no longer joins the north–south railway. The station runs only a short tourist train to Trại Mát.

seoTitle: Da Nang to Da Lat — about 1 hour 5 minutes by air
seoDescription: Da Nang to Lien Khuong is about 1 hour 5 minutes by air, each way. The airport is about 30 km south of Da Lat. No train. Road time is Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Is Da Lat back to Da Nang the same trip?
faqs.a: Yes. This page covers both directions. The return flight is also about 1 hour 5 minutes. The ride from Lien Khuong into town is extra.
No kilometre and no clock are published for the road from Da Nang to Da Lat. The minutes are Check on arrival. Use the flight if the day matters.
